scope: Follow recovered native ad classification into browser and native media admission

findings: 0x10047940 tests nonempty advideo and exact el=adunit, setting a classification byte.
Assembly 0x10047c64..0x10047c8a confirms length-six comparison and branch.
The byte is forwarded through 0x1004c620 and 0x1004dd20 into 0x100434d0; the latter stores the classification in its record at +0x28.
reference.limit: This traces classification in the installed legacy parser; it does not prove the full current ad-suppression algorithm or universal site coverage.

implementation: Reject explicit ad URL markers in video/audio choices, including cipher URL metadata and observed-URL promotion.
Prevent quality-list fallback from resurrecting a catalog containing only explicit ad URLs.
Reject marked page-level and browser-level SABR capture, and revalidate persisted browser sessions.
Reject marked native player fallback links; inspect every decoded query occurrence.
Preserve ordinary content URLs and original page fetch arguments, promise and response body.
limitations: Focused native executable rebuilt YouTubePlayer, Transfer and DownloadPreview; unchanged backend objects were reused.
The full native suite was not rerun for this patch. RC1 validation applies to its earlier source commit, not these changes.
Controlled VM mocks validate both browser bundles; they are not live Edge/Firefox playback acceptance.
No driver, registration, personal catalog or published RC1 artifact was changed.
